title: Black Filmmakers Hall of Fame — Binder OC-002
description: Working gallery of 35 items from one of several surviving BFHF binders: photographs by Jacob Blanchette Jr. from the 1987 Oscar Micheaux Awards, related film/contact materials, and a dated awards announcement.
status: Working public gallery · research and rights review ongoing
credits: Photographs by Jacob Blanchette Jr. (attributed by family); printed announcement creator not established.
eyebrow: Black Filmmakers Hall of Fame · Binder OC-002
gallery_description: Browse 35 preliminary digitizations from a BFHF binder, including mounted prints that the family identifies as Jacob's photographs of the February 22, 1987 Oscar Micheaux Awards. Contact-sheet materials include evidence of a Chicago Black Film Festival in June 1987. Original-page filters and item identifiers are provided.
notice: Working archival gallery: photographs attributed to Jacob Blanchette Jr. by family; some crops and tonal adjustments need review. The 27 mounted prints are associated with the February 22, 1987 Oscar Micheaux Awards by family testimony. A film/contact assembly includes a Chicago festival clapperboard dated June 1987. Individual identities, frame dates and reproduction rights remain under review.

title: Black Repertory Group — 25th Anniversary (1990)
description: First-pass gallery of 21 mounted photographs from the Black Repertory Group 25th anniversary album.
gallery_description: Twenty-one preliminary crops from six photographed album pages. Browse by provisional album page, search descriptions, or use the slideshow. Individual dates and identities remain unverified.
notice: Working digitization: several crops still need checking. The album title page dates the anniversary celebration July 20–22, 1990; that does not independently establish each photograph's date. Photographer credits and publication rights remain under review.
credits: From the Jacob Blanchette Jr. Photography Archive; individual photographers not yet verified.
